analyst.summary: Amber Enterprises is India's leading room-air-conditioner OEM manufacturer, with a fast-growing electronics-manufacturing side business. Core segment revenue grew a strong 33% year-on-year, but profitability (return on equity) remains low and the company pays no dividend, reinvesting instead in growth. The stock trades at a very rich valuation relative to today's profitability, though the growth behind it looks genuine rather than one-off. We rate it a Hold.
